ادارأت (form VI)
# اِدَّارَأْتُ (iddāraʔtu) /id.daː.raʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
# اِدَّارَأْتَ (iddāraʔta) /id.daː.raʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
# اِدَّارَأْتِ (iddāraʔti) /id.daː.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِدَّارَأَ (iddāraʔa)
# اِدَّارَأَتْ (iddāraʔat) /id.daː.ra.ʔat/: third-per
